new_candidates.body:
## Environment

- ROS 2 Lyrical, Ubuntu 26.04, `rmw_cyclonedds_cpp`, x86_64 and aarch64
- `ros-lyrical-ros-gz-sim` 3.0.10 (binary) and `ros_gz` branch `lyrical` at 3.0.12 (built from source)

## Description

When `ros_gz_sim::GzServer` runs as a component in `component_container_mt`, the container exits with SIGSEGV in most runs after SIGINT (8 of 10 runs with 3.0.10; 4 of 5 with 3.0.12).

`main()` returns 0. During `exit()`, the static rmw library handle in `rmw_implementation` unloads `librmw_cyclonedds_cpp`/`libddsc` while CycloneDDS threads are still running. One of them (`recv`, `tev` or `gc`) then returns into unmapped code, e.g. `ddsi_recv_thread+460` after `epoll_wait`.

The DDS threads still run because the default rclcpp context is never finalized (`rcl_context_fini`, `~Context` and `dds_delete_domain` are never called). The `use_count` of the default context at `exit()`:

| Setup | use_count |
|---|---|
| container + `composition::Talker` | 1 (only the static reference) |
| container + `GzServer`, empty world, 3.0.12 | 2 |
| full simulation with `ros_gz_bridge` 3.0.10 | 6 |
| full simulation with 3.0.12 | 2 |

With 3.0.12 the `RosGzBridge` cycle is gone (#952/#953, #977/#989), but `GzServer` still leaks one reference. `~GzServer` runs, but its `gz_server` node is never destroyed. We did not find which object holds the reference. Possible candidates (unverified): `GzSimulationInterfaces` (sub-node, detached thread with a `[&]` capture, handlers that hold a `shared_ptr<Node>`) and the executor of the TimeSource clock.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Load `ros_gz_sim::GzServer` into `component_container_mt` with an empty world.
2. Stop it with SIGINT.
3. In gdb, set a breakpoint on `exit` and print `rclcpp::contexts::get_global_default_context()` `use_count`: the result is 2, expected 1.

The crash itself is a race: with an empty world it shows up less often than in a full simulation.

## Expected behavior

All nodes are destroyed, the context is shut down and finalized, and the process exits with 0.

## Workaround

`LD_PRELOAD=<prefix>/lib/librmw_cyclonedds_cpp.so` on the container keeps the library mapped: 10 of 10 runs exited cleanly.
new_candidates.title: ros_gz_sim: GzServer component keeps a reference to the rclcpp context, process segfaults at exit

Hello lerobot maintainers,

This is a courtesy note and intentionally contains no vulnerability details.

A private security advisory for this repository has been submitted through GitHub's private vulnerability reporting and is awaiting maintainer review under Security > Advisories. Privately submitted reports do not always trigger a notification, so they can be easy to miss.

Could you please review the pending advisory when you have a chance? I am glad to coordinate on remediation and a disclosure timeline privately in the advisory thread.

Thank you,
Dilanka Kaushal Hewage (r3vpwnx)
